lines.text: How long to fall through the Earth? Step in, and let go.
lines.phonemes: hˌaʊ lˈɔŋ tə fˈɔːl θɹuː ðɪ ˈɜːθ? stˈɛp ˈɪn, ænd lˈɛt ɡˈoʊ.

lines.text: The tunnel runs straight through the middle of the planet, so long that driving it would take days. But you'll be falling.
lines.phonemes: ðə tˈʌnəl ɹˈʌnz stɹˈeɪt θɹuː ðə mˈɪdəl ʌvðə plˈænɪt, sˌoʊ lˈɔŋ ðæt dɹˈaɪvɪŋ ɪt wʊd tˈeɪk dˈeɪz. bˌʌt juːl biː fˈɔːlɪŋ.

lines.text: And gravity keeps pulling, until at the center you're moving about ten kilometers a second. Then that pull slows you on the way out, and you arrive just as you stop.
lines.phonemes: ænd ɡɹˈævᵻɾi kˈiːps pˈʊlɪŋ, ʌntˈɪl æt ðə sˈɛntɚ jʊɹ mˈuːvɪŋ ɐbˌaʊt tˈɛn kˈɪləmˌiːɾɚz ɐ sˈɛkənd. ðˈɛn ðæt pˈʊl slˈoʊz juː ɔnðə wˈeɪ ˈaʊt, ænd juː ɚɹˈaɪv dʒˈʌst æz juː stˈɑːp.

lines.text: That whole trip, the textbooks said, takes forty-two minutes. But they pictured the same stuff all the way down. A graduate student redid the sum with the real Earth, and its heavy core makes gravity grow stronger as you fall.
lines.phonemes: ðæt hˈoʊl tɹˈɪp, ðə tˈɛkstbʊks sˈɛd, tˈeɪks fˈɔːɹɾitˈuː mˈɪnɪts. bˌʌt ðeɪ pˈɪktʃɚd ðə sˈeɪm stˈʌf ˈɔːl ðə wˈeɪ dˈaʊn. ɐ ɡɹˈædʒuːət stˈuːdənt ɹᵻdˈɪd ðə sˈʌm wɪððə ɹˈiːəl ˈɜːθ, ænd ɪts hˈɛvi kˈɔːɹ mˌeɪks ɡɹˈævᵻɾi ɡɹˈoʊ stɹˈɔŋɡɚɹ æz juː fˈɔːl.

lines.text: So you fall faster, sooner, and come out the other side in about thirty-eight minutes. With nobody to catch you, you'd swing back through, forever.
lines.phonemes: sˌoʊ juː fˈɔːl fˈæstɚ, sˈuːnɚ, ænd kˈʌm ˈaʊt ðɪ ˈʌðɚ sˈaɪd ɪn ɐbˌaʊt θˈɜːɾiˈeɪt mˈɪnɪts. wɪð nˈoʊbɑːdi tə kˈætʃ juː, juːd swˈɪŋ bˈæk θɹˈuː, fɚɹˈɛvɚ.

lines.text: Lighten that core in the sum, and the answer drifts back toward the textbook's.
lines.phonemes: lˈaɪʔn ðæt kˈɔːɹ ɪnðə sˈʌm, ænd ðɪ ˈænsɚ dɹˈɪfts bˈæk təwˈɔːɹd ðə tˈɛkstbʊks.

lines.text: So a fall through the Earth is more than a ride. It's a way of weighing its heart.
lines.phonemes: sˌoʊ ɐ fˈɔːl θɹuː ðɪ ˈɜːθ ɪz mˈɔːɹ ðˌænɚ ɹˈaɪd. ɪts ɐ wˈeɪ ʌv wˈeɪɪŋ ɪts hˈɑːɹt.

lines.text: Next envelope: could everyone alive stand in one city?
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst ˈɑːnvəlˌoʊp: kʊd ˈɛvɹɪwˌʌn ɐlˈaɪv stˈænd ɪn wˈʌn sˈɪɾi?
